Thomas Hughes, Tom Brown’s School Days.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/thomas-hughes/tom-browns-school-days

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Thomas Hughes (annotator, author, role code ill), died 1896.

First publication of the text used (SE colophon: 'Tom Brown’s School Days was published in 1857 by Thomas Hughes.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published before 1931 (SE colophon: 'Tom Brown’s School Days was published in 1857 by Thomas Hughes.'), so it is in the United States public domain. The edition's rights statement below says the same.
- Country of origin: does not matter, because every person whose words are in the text died in 1925 or earlier. The text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last person to die died in 1896.
